candidate_windows.window_text:
We choose BERT-base-uncased (Devlin et al., 2019) from HuggingFace as the default pretrained encoder $\mathcal{F}$ . The max sequence length we set is 128. We choose AdamW as the optimizer with a warm up rate of 0.1. The training steps $T$ and $T'$ are set as 2000 and 200, respectively. We use the grid search to find the best hyper-parameters for each benchmark. As a result, the threshold $\theta$

and the margin $r$ are set as 0.8 and 3.0, respectively. We choose five random seeds from {12, 21, 42, 87, 100} and report the averaged results with standard deviations. We implement our model by Pytorch 1.8, and train the model with 8 V100-32G GPUs.
